correctness.rationale: The primary paper gives a unique geometric correspondence between 63 nonzero J[2] vectors and Steiner hexads and identifies order-48 12T31 on the source’s invariant hexad bitangents. The finite calculation constructs 28 odd theta characteristics q0(a,b)=a·b, 63 twelve-element Steiner sets H_v, the complete v-stabilizer U63 of order 23040, and the unique 12T31-invariant six-pair system. A freshly written independent Python group enumeration found the U63 restriction faithful, the lifted group of order 48, nonzero J[2] orbits 1,6,16,16,24, and fixed class exactly {v=1}. Therefore J(Q)[2]≅F2. The original article states that both sign Galois images are conjugate, so the result transfers. This is complete finite exhaustive group enumeration rather than sampling.
residual_risks: Relies on primary paper’s exact identification of 12T31 Galois image; group computation alone would not prove which curve has that image.
